description: Variable energy prices, split by AC (≤ 22 kW) and HDC (DC ≥ 150 kW) when present, derived from 2096 per-kWh prices across 1414 DE*MDS stations in the Mobilithek chargecloud stat feed (min–median–max per type). MENNEKES' network is primarily AC (≤ 22 kW). Prices incl. 19% VAT. Time-based blocking/parking fees (pricePerMinute) apply at some stations and are not included in the energy price. Ad-hoc payment (ratePolicy adHoc); price shown in-app before charging.
